summary: Hero with an operations dashboard on the right, built from real HTML panels: a service-line panel and one figure panel per stat. As the hero enters, the panels lift off the base plate into an exploded stack while the unit swings to a three-quarter view, then it holds still; fine pointers orbit the camera a few degrees. The dashboard is labelled as illustrative and only shows the page's own services and stats. Pitch, swing direction, layer order and gap are seeded from the brand name. Needs 3-6 service names and 2-4 real figures from the brief; fits managed service desks, IT-BPO partners and data operations teams that sell on reporting.
